standouts.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Jun 17 to Jul 29 (+33%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−9.4% to −14%), on lighter volume, with the June breakout level in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−19%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+6.9%) says wave 3 is under way.

standouts.text: On Oct 15 it gapped up out of a tight range on 8.6x volume and has held (+8.3% at the open).

standouts.head: Weekly chart: advancing
standouts.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.
standouts.text: On the weekly chart price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
